g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in and the offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning answers today). 'Not now' leaves home unchanged, and the ad-fails field covers both no game available and an unconfirmed play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers that expire at midnight, which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after a 3+ day gap for a non-subscriber, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes') and adds no cap on anything free. It only adds a sample of a paid feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits as app chrome on the Chats home (s01), which is rated safe. It is not inside a conversation or next to unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor. 'Advanced reasoning mode' (s02.e03, l02) is a paid Luzia+ paywall bullet, so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field says Luzia 'plays a 15-second video ad before every fifth answer'. No mechanic or element in the product model shows that, and the model says no free-tier limit was observed, so it is an unsupported claim about the app as it is today.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is a sample that ends: 3 answers or midnight, once per day and only after a 3+ day gap. The full feature stays behind the paid plans and it takes nothing from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears on the home screen at app open, before the user has started a task. It is a dismissible card on Chats, so it does not interrupt anything.

c6_fits_simula.reason: This is a play-to-earn sponsored game, and the card only changes to 'answers ready' after a verified play. The 'play isn't confirmed' path keeps the offer, and the trigger (a 3+ day gap in sessions) is detectable by the app.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names Advanced reasoning mode (s02.e03), the Luzia+ badge (s01.e02), the Chats home prompt card and the 3-day trial button, so it is tied to this app.

other_concern: The reward is labelled '(inference)'. The model doesn't show that the app can grant a metered number of Advanced reasoning answers. The 'each answer pays for itself' and regional-earnings claims are predictions and are unverified.
